domain_restrictions: Q is defined for inputs in the integers
base point is 0, which is an integer
z ranges over all integers in the successor and predecessor closure assumptions
z ranges over all integers in the conclusion
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For any predicate Q on integers: if Q(0) holds and Q is closed under moving from z to z+1 for all integers z and also closed under moving from z to z-1 for all integers z, then Q(z) holds for every integer z.
quantifier_order: for any predicate Q on integers
if for every integer z, Q(z) implies Q(z+1)
if for every integer z, Q(z) implies Q(z-1)
then for every integer z, Q(z) holds

variables.name: Q
variables.role: unary predicate being assumed and concluded

variables.name: z
variables.role: generic integer used in assumptions and the conclusion

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses are introduced; all quantification over z is universal
the predicate Q is fixed throughout the implication

statement_nl: For any predicate Q : ℤ → Prop, if Q(0) holds, if for every integer z one has Q(z) → Q(z + 1), and if for every integer z one has Q(z) → Q(z - 1), then Q(z) holds for every integer z.
